summary: Riverview Bancorp filed an 8-K announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $4.0 million of its common stock, effective August 20, 2026. Shares may be bought in open market or private transactions for up to 12 months. Management may enter a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan with Raymond James to execute repurchases during blackouts. No price per share or premium was stated; the program reflects excess capital deployment. Watch for actual repurchase pace and any impact on EPS; risk-arb angle is minimal as this is a routine buyback, not a tender offer.
